name: Akumu ~Aoi Kajitsu no Sanka~
source:
To fulfill his nightmarish fantasy, a guy took a busload of girls hostage. Out of 23(plus one) girls, he likes 10. What he does with them, you decide.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20050209185814/http://members.shaw.ca:80/lisun/jhag-wna.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
translation:
为了实现他的噩梦般的幻想，一个男人劫持了一车女孩作为人质。在23个（加1个）女孩中，他喜欢10个。他对她们做什么，你决定。

[来自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20050209185814/http://members.shaw.ca:80/lisun/jhag-wna.htm]李的欢乐屋[/url]]
